notes.title: System Invaders is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]
We are very pleased to announce the launch of our latest game, System Invaders! System Invaders is a game like none other. It resembles old games like Space Invaders, but better!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32082159/5961f805ea8ff09d1c194e31b41c6ae19ca71cff.gif[/img]


[b]Overview[/b]

System Invaders is a shoot em' up game where one's main objective is to destroy all viruses that have infected your computer. Experience waves upon waves of viruses and destroy them all!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32082159/7ecae5857dd4e0f708a88c1c4c061116b36af0d3.gif[/img]


[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Highly nostalgic gameplay and retro graphics,
[*] 5 Chapters, with over 125+ waves of enemies,
[*] Many types of enemies, bosses, and power-ups,
[*] Play with friends in local or online co-op,
[*] Enjoy tougher gameplay in hardcore mode,
[*] Unique in-house made soundtracks,
[*] Full controller support,
[*] Steam achievements, stats, and leaderboards,
[*] Steam cloud saving support,
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253110/System_Invaders

We greatly appreciate any feedback, compliment or criticism. It helps us navigate our way through the Game Development journey.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. We hope you enjoy your time within System Invaders.

- Prisma Games

notes.title: System Invaders Reveal!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone![/h3]
We are happy to announce that we've just publicly revealed our most recent game on steam, System Invaders!

It's a game where you experience waves upon waves of viruses that have infected your computer. 5 Chapters with over 125 Waves of enemies! Play with your friends in local or online co-op! Can you destroy all the viruses?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253110

notes.title: Prismatix now Free to Play!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Players![/b]

We wanted to announce that Prismatix is now free to play. This may come as a shock or a surprise, depending on if you bought the game or not.

The reason we did this was simple. We here at Prisma Games don't think a game as simple as Prismatix should cost anything, so we thought the best course of action was to make the game free to play, forever!

To the players that bought the game before this update, we regret to say that there are no bonuses due to the game's source code being old and corrupted, meaning we cannot add new updates or features.

[b]Thanks for understanding,
Prisma Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Release
notes.content:
Hello,

As most of you know, Prismatix had a lot of issues with its gameplay. I've went and fixed most known problems, as told to me by the community. The gameplay should now be a lot better and most importantly, a lot more enjoyable than before.

Here is a list of everything that has been added or fixed.

[h1]Added: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Leaderboards button in the main menu
    [*]Game tips at the end of the match
[/list]

[h1]Fixed: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Reworked Prism movement
    [*]Floating and spiked platforms spawning after each other
    [*]Light cubes and drones shooting too fast
    [*]Floating platforms falling too fast
    [*]Prism "Super Jump"
    [*]Prism landing on its corners
[/list]

[h1]Prismatix Mobile Version[/h1]

In the meantime, i've also been working on a mobile port of the game. That will be coming out very soon, and will also be free to download!

Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello,

After the games succesful launch, a lot of feedback has been given to me about the game and ups and downs. It turned out to have many problems that seemed to have slipped by me.

[h1] Update 1.1[/h1]

Because of the games many issues, it is my responsibility to fix anything that players feel is wrong with the game. This update which is currently in development, will hopefully try to make the game better by improving on its current problems.

Thank you.
